title: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 (packed FP4 head) — SGLang + DSpark block-7
slug_note: The code peak: 51.5 tok/s on the LRUCache probe, about 1.5x MTP. Gives the long essay back — 18.3 versus MTP's 24.1.

variation.quant_detail: W4A4 body with lm_head packed to FP4. ~1.7GB smaller on disk than the BF16-head twin.

engine.config: DSpark block-7 with 8 draft tokens, unquantized draft. torch.compile plus decode-graph caps, --num-continuous-decode-steps 2, prefill CUDA graphs off, flashinfer.

requirements.notes: ~22GB target + ~2.7GB DSpark draft + KV pool at mem-fraction 0.90.

measurements.method: bench/ndec.py two-call net-decode, median of 5, tokens counted from the server's completion_tokens via stream_options.include_usage
measurements.note: Block-7 is the measured code peak. Block-5 trades -16% code for +8% prose.

measurements.method: bench/ndec.py two-call net-decode, median of 5, tokens counted from the server's completion_tokens via stream_options.include_usage

measurements.method: bench/ndec.py two-call net-decode, median of 5, tokens counted from the server's completion_tokens via stream_options.include_usage; streamed, temperature 1.0, thinking on
measurements.note: Slightly beat MTP (21.0) on default chat with thinking on and no degrade. Thinking-off chat was a small MTP edge (22.0 / 21.3 here vs 24.6 / 23.4).

caveats: Not compatible with YaRN or context >262144 — same draft-config leak as DFlash2. Keep YARN=0 and CONTEXT_LENGTH=262144.
--cuda-graph-max-bs is a deprecated alias in this build; the DSpark stack uses --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 4.
--speculative-accept-threshold-acc below 1.0 measured worse. Leave it at 1.0.
The DSpark draft was trained on FP8, but switching the target to QUANT=fp8 did not lift acceptance.
Recorded on the older stock image with an event-counting script for the short-chat cell, where events did approximate single tokens. That is not true of the DFlash2 image.

2026-11-04 rows come from the SR-98 four-engine run, launched with the lab's own docker command (same checkpoint, image and DSpark block-7 draft, but memory fraction 0.50 and default KV cache) rather than ./start-dspark.sh. Same box, same script: 29.21 tok/s here vs 24.48 for the ggml-org GGUF + MTP on llama.cpp and 12.05 for this NVFP4 checkpoint on vLLM without drafting (short summarise prompt, median of 3).
